COMMENTS: I have been wanting a magnetic tool pad for some time. I didn’t need a fender-size as it woiuld not get a great deal of use. My primary need is for one to attach to my shop equipment when matining or fixing it. This one is very impressive from a strength standoint. It can hold the larger tools like channel locks, pliers, ratchets and large wrenches while in the vertical position. The largest one (the 9.625 x12.625) is perfect for most of my big tools, but it is limited as to the number of tools that would fit on it. An 11x14 would be ideal. The smallest of the three pads does a great job holding washers, nuts and bolts, etc. The long skinny one, smaller tools. The surface on both sides is like faux leather; it is smooth to the touch and does not scratch your paint. The kit also includes a ~30” telescoping pick-up magnet rated at 15# which can come in handy for reaching things that fall behind others. It will not, however, lift even 10# unless perhaps it is concentrated in a small cube or cylinder.

PRECISE RATING: 4 (good at doing what I need, at least one exceptional characteristic, probably would buy again) - deduction secondary to the smallish size for the price. If it were ~20% less exensive, it would be easily rate 5 stars.

review_text: I don‘t know about you, but it seems like I spend more time looking for dropped fasteners than I do actually fixing things. Enter the tool mat. The magnets are really strong, the pickup tool is a great help and it seems to me to be a quality product. I like the PU leather look and feel. What I like best about the product is that I can lay out the fasteners in the order that I remove them and they stay in place on the mat. That way I know exactly where each screw or bolt came from and I can keep track of where they go back in place. The mat is large enough for any single job I might do. I guess my only quibble is that it is expensive, but over time, it should pay back in terms of the time saved.

review_text:
This is a set of 3 heavy duty tool mats and a telescoping magnet. The mats are fantastic. They‘re very heavy duty and I am expecting them to hold up for years to come. I’m not sure what the outer material is but it’s very stiff and seems to hold up well under moderate abuse. Out of curiosity, I tool the larger pad and did some basic “testing" (if you can even call it that). I tossed it into an old box of old rusty tools multiple times. I did this over and over to see if anything would end up penetrating the mat. Nothing did end up penetrating the mat. I stepped on the mat multiple times. I kicked it around. I took it and shut the hood onto the mat. I even took my from door and closed the door pretty hard while the large mat was in the way of the door closing. I was expecting this mst to break or tear at some point and it never did. I was originally not fond of the price but after seeing the larger mat hold up to all the abuse I put it through, I have thoroughly changed my mind. These mats are great. They also have strong magnets inside of them so not only do tools and bolts stick to the mats very well, but the mats themselves also stick to metal surfaces as well. I stick one on the side of my car and it took quite a bit of pulling for me to pull it off the car. Again, I was quite stunned at how well it stuck to the car’s surface.
The telescoping magnet is just an extra in my opinion. It’s okay, but the mats are the main attraction in my opinion. I have several telescoping magnets and the one that came with this set is probably the nicest one I own. I’m very satisfied with these mats and telescoping magnet.

review_text:
Sometimes a product isn’t flashy or stylish, but it’s so extremely useful that it still stands out. That’s what we have here. For your convenience, I’ll divide the rest of this review between the pickup pen and the mats.

First let’s talk about the pen. Now, this isn’t the first telescoping pickup device I’ve used. For years, my household has had a couple of little ones laying around, in case we dropped something behind the couch or under the radiator. You probably know the sort: They look and function almost exactly like presentation pointers, except they have a small magnet at the tip that can pick up anything from a paperclip to a very small screw. Last year, my wife got one at the other end of the size chart, which collapses to the size of the average flashlight, but slightly narrower, with a large and powerful magnet at the end. This product lies in the Goldilocks zone between those others. It’s compact and narrow compared to my wife’s macro-gadget, with a nice ergonomic grip and a pocket clip. The magnet is slightly smaller than hers, allowing it to fit into places hers can’t, but still powerful enough to lift virtually anything I can anticipate wanting to use it on. Screws and hand tools? This pen will do the job. Pot lid? No problem. Lawnmower? No, but that would be stupid to try anyway. It’s solidly constructed, easy to use, and convenient to carry or store. Whoever designed it clearly understood the assignment.

Okay, now the mats. Honestly, I wasn’t sure I needed these when I placed the order, but they looked like they might come in handy to stop screws or nails from rolling away while I was working. Generally I’ve relied on the old trick of using a small drinking cup, but I was open to an upgrade. My expectations weren’t that high. I figured maybe the mats would hold on well enough that minor bumps from working or a light breeze wouldn’t send me scrambling for the pickup pen, but not much more. This is one of those times I was delighted to be wrong. These mats have a strong magnetic field! Sure, I can lay them out on a work table, but they’ll also stick securely to a vertical surface! I sometimes need to take apart our window air conditioners for cleaning, and now I’ll be able to slap one of the pads on the unit’s outer casing and just stick the screws to it as I remove them from the unit, confident that they’ll stay securely in place until I need them for reassembly! The mats feel sturdy and adhere well. Full marks! Glad the set includes three of them, because my wife very quickly claimed one for her projects!

Overall, this is one of those products that’s well thought out and well executed. I’d buy it again without hesitation.
